subject: Renewal kickoff, milestones & QBR scheduling
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal kickoff: HelioHealth — timeline & QBR

Hi Alice —

Thanks for the continued partnership — excited to kick off the renewal conversation for HelioHealth (HLX-3421). To make this low-friction for your team, I sketched a compact kickoff plan and a few asks below.

High-level milestones (proposed)
- Week 0 (this week): mutual action plan and stakeholder list exchanged
- Week 1: QBR + demo of new batching/quantization savings tailored to your workloads
- Week 2: Legal & procurement review of term amendment / uplift options
- Week 3: Final sign + handoff to onboarding/ops for capacity changes

Immediate asks for you:
1) Confirm primary renewal contact(s) + procurement contact (if different)
2) Any expected capacity uplift (burst or steady) over next 12 months? rough ballpark is fine
3) Preferred QBR windows — we can host a 45-minute slot with tech + CS + your product owner

I attached a one-page mutual action plan (HLX-MAP-v1.pdf) and created a quick calendar poll for QBR times: https://calendar.google.com/poll/helio-qbr-poll.

Possible QBR windows (PST) we can open this week:
- Tue 5/31 10:00–10:45 or 14:00–14:45
- Wed 6/1 09:00–09:45 or 15:00–15:45

If procurement needs any advance info (SLA, data retention language, SOC 2 artifacts), flag who to send to and we’ll push a package.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate on our side: Monica (CS) will run the QBR, Stephanie (solutions) will join for terms/upsell ops.

— Connor
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123

[Attachment: HLX-MAP-v1.pdf (PDF)]

From: Alice Chen <alice@heliohealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@heliohealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@heliohealth.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: HelioHealth — timeline & QBR

Connor —

Perfect, thanks for the clear plan. Quick responses:
- Primary renewal contact: me (Alice Chen, Head of ML). Procurement point: procurement@heliohealth.com.
- Capacity: we expect a ~40% steady growth in tokens for billing year starting July, and two planned seasonal bursts (Sept + Nov) — likely need burst capacity for Sept. I don’t have exact token counts today, we can pull those for the QBR.
- QBR windows: Tue 5/31 14:00–14:45 works best for me.

I’ve looped in Ben (product) and procurement. Procurement will need the SOC 2 summary, data retention options, and the licensing amendment draft when you have it. If you can share the mutual action plan and a short summary of the uplift options (tiered commit vs burst credits), that’ll be helpful for our internal review.

Thanks — looking forward to the QBR.

— Alice
Alice Chen
Head of Machine Learning | HelioHealth
alice@heliohealth.com

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: HelioHealth — timeline & QBR

Hi Alice — thanks for the quick reply and for looping procurement + Ben. I’m Monica (Customer Success) and I’ll run the QBR. A few quick items from our side so procurement has context ahead of time: 

- SOC 2: we’ll send a one-page summary + a pointer to the attestation artifact.
- Licensing amendment: Stephanie (cc) will draft two options for term + commit — (A) 12-month staircase commit with burst credits, (B) 24-month discounted commit with predictable throughput.
- Capacity ask: bring whatever usage exports you can to the QBR (tokens per day/month, top endpoints). We’ll use that to model cost and recommend a path.

I created a calendar poll with slots Connor proposed: https://calendar.google.com/poll/helio-qbr-poll — I marked Tue 5/31 14:00 as a preferred option for our team. I’ll send the SOC 2 one-pager and a short uplift options deck in a follow-up.

Next steps (summary)
1) Connor: finalize MAP and confirm internal owners (done) — attached.
2) Alice/Helio: confirm QBR 5/31 14:00 and pull token usage exports.
3) Stephanie: prepare two term amendment drafts + pricing sketches for the QBR.
4) Monica: SOC 2 one-pager and short uplift options deck (send before QBR).

Thanks — see you (virtually) Tue.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica@redwoodinference.com

[Attachment: qbr-calendar-poll.ics (calendar poll)]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: HelioHealth — timeline & QBR

Alice / Procurement — thanks for the fast turnaround and for confirming Tue 5/31 14:00–14:45 PST for the QBR. Quick summary and how we’ll prep: 

Confirmed QBR: Tue, 31 May 2026, 14:00–14:45 PST (45m) — virtual link will be sent in the calendar invite.
Owners & roles during QBR:
- Monica (CS): QBR facilitation + capacity modeling
- Stephanie (Solutions): pricing & term options, amendment Q&A
- Connor (AE): executive sponsor + next-step orchestration

Pre-read we will send by EOD Monday:
- HLX-MAP-v1.pdf (mutual action plan)
- SOC 2 one-pager + attestation pointer
- Short uplift options summary (Option A / Option B)

Procurement ask: if you want a track-changesable draft amendment prior to the QBR, let us know and Stephanie will circulate a redline by COB Mon. Otherwise we’ll present the options in the QBR and circulate drafts after.

Action items (quick):
- Alice: confirm if procurement prefers the draft ahead of the QBR (yes/no)
- Procurement: flag any hard blocks (SLA numbers / retention constraints) we should be aware of
- Connor/Monica/Stephanie: send pre-read materials Mon EOD

Thanks — I’ll send the calendar invite and the virtual link once the poll is finalized.

— Connor
